name: com.aiapi-pro/novai-prices
title: NovAI Prices
description: Live prices for 116 Chinese models; batch cost calculators for video and images.

tools.name: cheapest_models
tools.description: List the cheapest Chinese AI models from NovAI's live price feed, ranked by a comparable cost unit (text: 1M input + 200K output; video: 5-second clip; image: per image). Use this when the user asks which model is cheapest, wants to compare costs, or is choosing a model by budget. For a batch cost estimate at list price, see https://aiapi-pro.com/video-cost-calculator (video) and https://aiapi-pro.com/image-cost-calculator (images).

category.description: Video, Image, Chat / LLM, Audio, 3D, Embedding

max_price.description: only models whose comparable cost is at or below this USD figure

tools.name: model_price
tools.description: Look up the NovAI list price of a Chinese AI model by name fragment (seedance, kimi, glm, qwen, doubao, hunyuan, minimax...). Use this when the user asks what a specific model costs, or wants a price before choosing one. Returns the provider list price, the unit (per 1M tokens / per image / per generation) and the model id. Per-minute video costs with every row sourced: https://aiapi-pro.com/video-cost-2026

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the model categories available in NovAI's price feed (Chat / LLM, Video, Image, Audio, 3D, Embedding) with the number of models in each. Use this first when the category for a request is unclear, then call cheapest_models with that category. Machine-readable feed: https://aiapi-pro.com/china-ai-leaderboard.json
